newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila strictly monitoring banks' dlr position.
newsitem.headline: Manila strictly monitoring banks' dlr position.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Thursday it had ordered all commercial banks to report their daily dollar positions under oath.
Previously, banks were reporting their positions daily but without the legal imprimatur.

"The Monetary Board yesterday agreed to require all banks to give us a statement under oath of their position, oversold or overbought position, every day beginning Friday last week," central bank governor Gabriel Singson said.
He said the statement should be duly notarised and signed by at least the senior vice president.
Under the central bank rule, banks are allowed to be short or long on dollars up to a certain extent.

Banks' overbought position should not exceed 20 percent of their excess foreign exchange liabilities, while the dollar oversold position should not exceed 10 percent of their excess foreign exchange assets.
